subsystems.holistic:
This is the strongest large module I have reviewed at this ambition level, and the grade reflects genuinely mature engineering with a small number of real gaps concentrated in the newest layers. The one-week kernel (pulseKernel.js) composes roughly twenty movers under a visible, consistently applied constitution: every mover is dormancy-gated with an explicit byte-identity argument in its header; every cross-tick ledger is read-last/write-next; every rng draw is keyed-fork order-independent (with the one deliberate shared 'war-layer' label documented as safe and fenced with an invariant note); wall-clock is structurally excluded (assertNowPinnedInTest at both kernel and orchestrator mouths); and conditional worldState ledgers are materialized through a single catalog whose array order is explicitly the serialized-bytes contract. The pause/resume/dismiss state machine is the most impressive part: the residue-strip discipline has graduated from prose to a machine-enforced registry (RESIDUE_STRIP_SITES + marker sync test + a test-gated read-only leak assert), and the dismiss path conserves population, exhaustion, disposition deltas, and occupation seeds with per-id tagging. The supporting modules are similarly disciplined — stressor counterforces/synergies/gates are one catalog-driven vocabulary with receipts, clamps, and explicit design notes for every asymmetry; codepoint-vs-locale sorting is a house rule with rationale at every sort that picks a winner.

The real defects cluster where the newest waves read the tick's outcome stream. The dismissal discipline that scrubs war-ledger residue does not extend to the post-apply consequence readers: moral drift, belief-misjudgment news, and the tempo fold all iterate the unfiltered selectedForApply, so a DM-dismissed march still corrupts the actor's alignment, headlines a march that never happened, and burns a tempo birth (finding 1) — exactly the write-survives-one-path-ghosts-another class this codebase otherwise engineers against. Second-order issues are receipts drifting from reality (the candidate-count omission found in round 1 persists and was repeated by the new lifecycle lane), silent pending-proposal eviction under the forcing modes' 80-ring, and a resume cursor that recomputes rather than carries the advance-start tick, weakening a round-1 fix on multi-segment advances.

As simulation substance the slice is excellent: mechanisms compose (mobilization gates deploys, beliefs gate targeting, reasons load choices, treaties feed grievances), counterparts exist by design, and legibility is a first-class output — counterforce breakdowns, casus belli lines, resolution receipts all reach the DM's eye. As product surface the main risks are feed-significance inflation (status-quo strategy postures read as 'major') and the proposal-docket trust issue above. Structurally, the 2,450-line kernel function is at the edge of maintainability — the composition order is comment-borne, and the add-a-lane-update-three-lists pattern has now bitten twice; a composed lane registry would remove that habitat. Round 1 graded the predecessor slice A-; the fifteen waves since have raised substance materially while keeping discipline, but the consequence-reader gap and the repeated bookkeeping omission keep it at A-.
strengths: Machine-enforced residue discipline: RESIDUE_STRIP_SITES registry + @residue-strip marker sync test + assertNoResidueLeak (test-gated, read-only) turn the pause/dismiss byte-equivalence invariant from convention into an enforced contract.

Determinism engineering is best-in-class: keyed rng forks everywhere (order-free), pinned-now structural guards at both kernel and orchestrator mouths, codepoint sorts with explicit locale-collation warnings at every winner-picking sort, and documented fork-label collision safety.

Dormancy/additivity constitution is uniformly applied: every mover block carries its own byte-identity argument, conditional ledgers materialize through one ordered catalog (serialized-byte contract stated), and the spatialDigest freeze-and-share optimization converts a never-written convention into an enforced guarantee.

Catalog-driven stressor dynamics (counterforces, synergies, spawn gates) share one source vocabulary, emit reasons on every candidate, and clamp every composition — crises are explainable and un-runaway by construction.

Read-last/write-next timing discipline (disposition ratchet, pantheon, conquest feeds, commitments) is stated and honored at every seam, with conditional key-drop hygiene returning dormant worlds to absent keys.
applyFactionPatch's union-merge for late-accepted proposals and mergeStressorUpsert's commutative field-merge show real care for the proposal-accepted-ticks-later lifecycle path.

findings.title: Pending proposals are silently evicted by the 80-record ring under dm_only/recommendations during long advances
findings.evidence: `proposals: [...byId.values()].slice(-MAX_PROPOSALS)` (upsertProposal; MAX_PROPOSALS=80, line 10) — no status-aware pruning, no expiry receipt. rollCandidates admits up to 5 proposals/tick; candidateEvents' autonomy routing forces EVERY stochastic family to 'proposal' under dm_only/recommendations.
findings.why: A one_year advance (52 weekly ticks) under the forcing modes can mint ~260 proposals; the ring keeps the last 80, silently dropping pending decisions the DM never saw — including possibly still-pending ones — with no 'expired' stamp. The actor-major lane expires visibly (expire-to-decline); ordinary proposals just vanish. This undermines the exact DM-authority contract the forcing modes exist to provide.
findings.fix_shape: Prune resolved (applied/dismissed/expired/refused) records first; give pending overflow a visible expire-to-decline stamp mirroring expireStaleActorMajors; or raise/partition the cap for forcing modes. Bold: one proposal-docket module owning retention policy with receipts.

subsystems.holistic:
The war core is the most mature simulation surface I have reviewed in this codebase, and it reads like production engine code written by someone who has been burned by every classic sim bug and built the antibody for each. The phantom-siege class is structurally retired by a single provenance-gated read module (warFrontReads.js) that warDeployment, deploymentReturn, occupation, and the transit kernels all share. The homeostasis loop is genuinely closed: feasibility gate → plausible-band roll → non-reverting exhaustion scar → age-scaled drain → hard SIEGE_MAX_AGE ceiling → withdrawal with disposition consequences, and each stage documents which force terminates a stalemate. Conservation is taken seriously to an unusual degree — the levy/conscription/homecoming path apportions survivors back to each contributing vassal by largest-remainder rounding so per-settlement AND world totals conserve, with war dead as the only sink. The three round-1 war findings (deployment prune on vanished settlements, defender disposition wins, occupied-settlement deploy gate) are all verifiably fixed in the current code with in-code finding references — the fix program is real, not cosmetic.

The weakness is concentrated in the two newest waves, convergence and navy, which shipped behind default-off virtual flags with excellent pure primitives but incomplete lifecycle wiring. The naval ledger is the clearest case: land transit self-prunes by re-deriving records from live deployments every tick, but the naval kernel carries every prior record forward and nothing retires an arrived convoy, a convoy whose escorted deployment resolved, or a record whose owner left the canon — so one convoy permanently locks that navy out of all future operations and the ledger never drops. This is exactly the owner's most-bitten class (a write that survives one path and ghosts another). Convergence advertises occupation-on-overstay in its design and header, ships and pin-tests the pure function, but deletes intervention records the same tick their contest resolves, so the mechanism is unreachable; three of its five aftermath states are never assigned. The one-army law is enforced in only one direction between the deployments and interventions ledgers. None of these are recorded deferrals — I checked.

As product surface, legibility is strong: every mint, abandonment, misjudgment, battle, and blockade emits a house-voice receipt; the counterpart criterion is honored (every organic mover has a registered realm verb through the W-COMPOSER-2 lift, with force ≡ organic at the applier). Constitution compliance is exemplary — virtual flags, drop-when-empty spatial ledgers, byte-identity reasoning at every seam, stable fork keys, codepoint-sorted iteration, and no wall-clock or Math.random anywhere in the slice. The recorded NUL cache-key delimiter in supplyCompleteness.js:158 remains as §0.0.2 documents it. The grade lands at A- rather than A because the newest waves' lifecycle gaps are genuine correctness debt in shipped (if dark) code, and because a couple of advertised mechanisms (fog-driven wrong-village strikes, lasting DM casus decrees) are weaker in code than their documentation claims.
strengths: warFrontReads.js — one shared provenance-gated siege-read module structurally retires the phantom-siege bug class across four consumers

Closed homeostasis loop: feasibility gate, exhaustion scar, age-scaled drain, hard SIEGE_MAX_AGE deterministic ceiling — a war cannot grind forever, and each closer documents which pathology it terminates
Conservation discipline: sack/levy/conscription/homecoming form an audited two-sided transfer system with largest-remainder per-vassal apportionment; war dead are the only sink

Round-1 findings (worldpulse-war-7/8/9) verifiably fixed in current code with in-code finding citations; suppression/dismissal residue-strip machinery (deploy residue, vassalization rollback) is unusually thorough

Constitutional hygiene throughout: virtual flags with fail-closed === true gates, drop-when-empty spatial ledgers, stable rng fork keys, codepoint-sorted iteration, byte-identity rationale documented at every seam
Land/sea parity by construction — sea battles reuse resolveFieldBattle verbatim on a commensurate strength scale; blockade-is-a-siege rides the existing interdiction seam rather than parallel math
Receipts culture: every mint/abandon/battle/misjudgment/blockade emits house-voice news with named causes, satisfying the legibility bar

findings.title: navalTransit records never retire: arrived convoys and orphaned records persist forever, permanently locking a navy out of future operations
findings.evidence: "for (const key of Object.keys(prior).sort()) { ... records[key] = stepArmyPosition(rec, nowTick); }" — all prior records carry forward; the only removal is sea-battle loss (delete records[loserKey]). Contrast armyTransitKernel.js:211-240, which re-derives records from live deployments each tick (self-pruning). No caller prunes on hasArrived, deployment resolution, or canon membership (grep: navalTransit consumers are supplyKernel guard, momentum reads, realmVerbExecution mints/one delete).
findings.why: The owner's most-bitten class: a convoy whose siege resolved (or that simply arrived, position01=1) persists forever; both convoy-derive and blockade-derive skip any navy with a record ('the fleet is already at sea'), so one convoy is a one-shot lobotomy for that navy; the ledger never drops (dormancy drop-when-empty unreachable); records for removed settlements also persist.
findings.fix_shape: Mirror the land kernel: prune any naval record whose escorted deployment is gone/recalled-and-home, whose convoy hasArrived plus a return leg (or immediate stand-down), or whose owner/target left snapshot.byId. Add a pin: convoy arrives → record retires within N ticks; navy can re-operate.
findings.deferral_checked: Not in playbook §0.0.2/§0.6; DESIGN_NAVY §7 pins list no convoy-retirement pin; W-NAVY postdates the round-1 register; no in-file deferral note covers record retirement.

findings.title: One-army law enforced in only one direction: an intervening settlement can still open a siege (deployments gate never consults the interventions ledger)
findings.evidence: Step 4: "if (deployments[fromId]) continue; // one-army constraint" — no read of the interventions spatial ledger (grep confirms zero 'interventions' references in warDeployment.js). convergence.js:967-970 enforces only the reverse ("busy = new Set(Object.keys(deployments))").
findings.why: convergence.js:47-49 claims "a settlement cannot besiege AND intervene" and DESIGN_CONVERGENCE.md:108-109 states the one-army law as bidirectional physics; in the lit world a settlement that committed an intervention column last tick passes every deploy gate and fields a second army, breaking the stated invariant and double-counting its strength.
findings.fix_shape: In warDeployment step 4, skip fromId when interventionActive(worldState) and the interventions ledger holds any record with interId === fromId (a cheap lazy read; 0 when dark ⇒ byte-identical). Pin: intervening settlement blocked from opening a siege until its column returns.
findings.deferral_checked: The in-file JUDGMENT (convergence.js:42-50) records the isolated-ledger choice and the forward direction only; playbook W-CONVERGENCE deferral list (verbs, INTERCEPT seam, rebellion tilts) does not cover the reverse gate.

findings.title: Occupation-on-overstay is orphaned: designed, tuned, and pin-tested but unreachable — intervention records are deleted the same tick their contest resolves
findings.evidence: "if (liveTargets.has(rec.target)) continue; // still contested — no aftermath yet / delete next[k];" — records exit immediately on resolution; no resolvedTick is ever stamped and overstayOccupation (line 685, OVERSTAY_TICKS=4) has zero src callers outside convergence.js (grep). RETREATED/BESIEGING/SCREENING states are also never assigned (only HOLDING/ATTRITED are written).
findings.why: DESIGN_CONVERGENCE.md:36 lists "on overstay after victory — the OCCUPATION transition" as a wave feature and the pin table (line 158) names it; a victorious intervener converting to occupier is the design's bridge into the occupation layer, and it can never fire — an advertised mechanism that is dead code in the live path.
findings.fix_shape: Stamp resolvedTick on records whose contest resolved instead of deleting; dwell them, call overstayOccupation each tick, feed its conquest-shaped outcome into freshConquestsFrom, and delete on occupy-or-depart. Alternatively record it as an explicit deferral row — today it is neither wired nor recorded.
findings.deferral_checked: Playbook W-CONVERGENCE row's deferral list names verbs/INTERCEPT-seam/rebellion-tilts only — overstay absent; DESIGN_CONVERGENCE lists it as landed scope, not a seam.

findings.title: A blockade has no organic end: peace or hostility-normalization never lifts it, leaving a standing strangulation that contradicts the settled war
findings.evidence: hostileOwners gates only NEW mints (pickBlockadeTarget); no leg removes a BLOCKADE record when the owner–target relationship stops being hostile. Removal paths found: sea-battle loss (navalKernel.js:379) and the DM's FORCE_RECONSIDERATION momentum crack (realmVerbExecution.js:410-417). blockadeStrangulationOf keeps feeding the economic_strangulation peace reason meanwhile.
findings.why: Blockade-is-a-siege is the owner's law, and sieges have three closers (withdrawal, ceiling, recall); the blockade has none that fires organically. Perverse loop: strangulation drives the target to sue for peace, peace lands, the blockade persists and keeps strangling — simulation incoherence on the sea half of the parity law.
findings.fix_shape: Add an organic lift: in advanceNaval, retire a BLOCKADE record whose owner–target pair is no longer hostile (or whose momentum course cracked), with a lift news beat; mirror the land layer's stale-front retirement. Pin: peace label lands → blockade lifts within one tick.

findings.title: DECLARE_CASUS decree survives exactly one tick: the reason fold recomputes every pair from state-derived scorers and silently drops any decreed record they do not back

A DM who declares a casus and ticks twice sees their decree vanish with no receipt — surprising, unrecorded semantics on a paid-surface verb.
findings.fix_shape: Carry decreed records through the fold with explicit decay (e.g. a decreedUntilTick or a per-tick score ramp-down over ~8 ticks, max-merged with the state-derived score), or document one-tick semantics in the verb's manifest prose and glossary. Pin either way.

findings.fix_shape: Either derive presence from the occupations ledger itself (an occupation younger than N ticks counts as garrisoned, decaying), or stamp a garrison flag on the occupation record at conquest that resistance/state advances consume — and delete the dead read.

subsystems.holistic:
This slice is the psychology-and-politics crown of the engine, and most of it earns its ambition. The belief-to-decision-to-consequence chain is genuinely closed: rumors fold into banded beliefs (provenance × recency × independence × completeness, credibility-weighted when info-statecraft is lit), beliefs feed the Blainey margins in both directions (self reads truth, the foe reads belief, a proven liar's signals regress toward the neutral midpoint), the margins feed typed peace reasons, the reasons feed the sue-for-peace softmax, the peace mints duration-capped treaties whose strain feeds revanchism back into the war reasons. The momentum threshold law is honored in the math, not just the comments — I verified every factor is floored (reversal factor ≥ 0.05, cliff ≥ 0.2×BASE, credibility weight ≥ 0.35, belief discount ≥ 0.4, climb-down price ≥ 0.15): there is no absorbing state anywhere in the slice. Dormancy discipline is uniform and real (virtual flags absent from defaults, drop-when-empty, serialize-compare, read-last/write-next), the corruption leash resolver chokepoint is consumed consistently by both the exposure path and the foreign-asset registry, and the blowback triple is fully wired through the kernel including both-court legitimacy hits. Round-1 fixes (belief seed sentinel, actor-attribution disposition seam, orientation-independent triage) are all intact — no regressions found.

The weaknesses cluster in the newest wave, settlementPolitics.js, whose two "who DOES" inputs are silently dead: leaderAlignmentKinship can never resolve because npcStates.alignment is a categorical string ('lawful_good') while alignmentAxes expects numeric axes — and the expression that would read them has an operator-precedence bug that misparses the ternary anyway — so the §B faith×alignment quadrant gate always reads neutral; and settlementUnderThreat probes six settlement fields (underSiege, besieged, mobilizationState, warPosture, threatLevel, embattlement) that no engine code ever writes onto settlements, so the §4 external-threat rally, survival blocs, and threat glue never fire. Both degrade to neutral rather than wrong, which is why the wave's tests pass, but two of the design's five discriminating axes are inert. The same wave's receipts — formation, fracture, exposure, the leader-rivalry deferral the design celebrates — are computed and then discarded by the kernel, and no display surface reads politicsLedgers, so the layer is currently invisible to the DM despite §6's explicit legibility promise. In momentum, the "cautious lowers entry, not exit" law is declared (TRAIT_MOMENTUM_ENTRY_ONLY) but consumed nowhere: cautious/wary currently lower the exit cliff, the opposite of the design sentence. And the Stage-4 crack's strict recalled.tick === now pin looks like it misses the proposal-lane peace (a DM-accepted sue_for_peace stamps the recall at accept-time tick T, while the crack only charges at pulse tick T+1) — the climb-down price would then bind only autoresolve campaigns.

As product surface the treaty document read-model, the causal brief, misjudgment news, and climb-down receipts are excellent legibility work; the politics and corruption-web deferral channels are the gap. As code it is disciplined, heavily commented, deterministic, and consistent across nine authors' worth of waves — the defects are integration seams, not rot.
strengths: No absorbing states anywhere: every psychology factor is explicitly floored and I verified the arithmetic (courseConsistencyFactor reversal >= 0.05, cliffStockFor floor 0.2x BASE, credibilityWeight floor 0.35, commitment discount floor 0.4, climb-down price floor 0.15) - the momentum threshold law ('weights never walls') holds mechanically, and succession-rerolls-the-cliff is genuinely emergent from live entityThreshold reads

Uniform constitutional discipline across all six waves: virtual flags with no DEFAULT_SIMULATION_RULES entry, immediate no-op dormancy gates, drop-when-empty + serialize-compare persistence, codepoint-sorted permutation-independent folds, and read-last/write-next staggering (belief discount reads last tick's commitments; sight postures shape next tick's beliefs)

The Blainey chain is consumed in BOTH directions exactly as designed: credibility discounts the subject-side margin reads in advancePeaceReasons, the same stock is charged by lies, spies, fractures (idempotent at mint tick), and climb-downs, and the war/peace reason ledgers load deploy and sue_for_peace weights symmetrically at the strategy seam

resolveLeash chokepoint discipline held: npcAgency exposure attribution, corruptionWeb's derived asset registry, and the innocent-guild fix all route through the one resolver; foreign exposure annotation is captured at the moment the leash is in hand (ousting-proof)

Round-1 findings verified fixed and not regressed: the belief seed sentinel (BELIEF_SEED_KEY, spatial-engine-5), the actor-attribution disposition seam (actorSaveId on raid/tribute/sanction/embargo), orientation-independent triage with hash01 tie-breaks throughout the relationship rules

Legibility craftsmanship where it IS wired: treatyDocument/frayingTermOf ('the peace holds by two terms of five; the tribute frays'), warCausalBrief irony read-model, misjudgment news, climb-down receipts naming depth-past-cliff and the face-saving off-ramp

findings.evidence: `const good = Number(al.good ?? al.morality ?? st.malice01 != null ? (1 - Number(st.malice01)) : NaN);` parses as `(al.good ?? al.morality ?? (st.malice01 != null)) ? (1-Number(st.malice01)) : NaN`. Traced: the only npcStates alignment writer is ensureNpcStates (npcAgency.js:536) which writes `alignment: pick(local, ALIGNMENTS)` — a string like 'lawful_good'; no writer of law/good axes or malice01 exists on npcStates (repo grep).

If numeric axes are ever added, the misparse discards al.good/al.morality entirely.

Add a pin: two lawful_good leaders yield kinship 1, lawful_good vs chaotic_evil yields 0.

findings.evidence: `export const TRAIT_MOMENTUM_ENTRY_ONLY = Object.freeze(new Set(['cautious', 'wary']));` — repo grep: zero consumers. npcMomentumScore sums ALL TRAIT_MOMENTUM weights including cautious(-0.4)/wary(-0.3) into temperamentMomentumOf → entityThreshold → cliff. subsystems.holistic:
This slice is the engine's newest muscle — the upswing arcs, the calamity bucket, resource discovery/removal, settlement birth-and-death, and the completed generosity engine — and as code it is impressively disciplined. Every mover honors the constitution the same way: a fail-closed virtual-flag dormancy gate that returns the same references untouched, drop-when-empty conditional ledgers under the FP-R spatialLedgers namespace, codepoint-sorted iteration, keyed rng forks (or full determinism), catch-up-safe tick-stamp dwell timers, and receipts on every step including deferral-visible cap/absorption refusals. Force ≡ organic is not a slogan here — it is structurally enforced through shared resolvers (resolveStrikeOnSettlement, mintSteading, buildTerminalDeathOutcome/buildResettleOutcome) and single writers wired into applyWorldPulse, with the W-COMPOSER-2 manifest genuinely consuming the same entry factories. The W-DISCOVERY↔W-UPSWING seam is consumed correctly in both directions (vein_exhausted feeds the bust flip; resource_strike joins the boom source taxonomy and the mining-camp birth), and round-1 religion findings are visibly fixed in place with finding-ID annotations — good program hygiene.

The weaknesses are almost all composition seams BETWEEN waves rather than local bugs, which is exactly what you'd expect from fifteen waves landing in three days. The most systemic: the lifecycle design's own constitution line — "movers skip it" for dead settlements — is enforced nowhere outside the two lifecycle modules. A terminal-dead remnant keeps its prosperity band, legitimacy score, and calamityHistory, so the upswing can arm a reconstruction on the corpse (the very calamity that killed it is a within-window trigger), the annual calamity draw can re-strike a ruin and print a "0 dead" beat, and flourishing could found an Academy on a grave. Second: the generosity engine's own hard-reserve-floor law bends under same-tick multi-receiver gifts — every ask prices against the same pre-transfer headroom, and the designed remedy (triageAllocation, "two claimants, one granary") is built, tested, and consumed by nothing. Third: small conservation/hysteresis frays — the upswing's repayment fold double-decays the whole obligations ledger on maturation ticks, the boom's documented cooling band is dead code (booms only end in bust), and a dead parent strands its satellite steadings outside the Σ-conservation story.

As simulation substance this slice finally gives the engine its up-signal, and it does so honestly: booms are named compositions of real trade throughput, reconstruction debits real ally credit, satellites are conserved population transfers, and the relic-ruin scarcity law and fates boundary hold at the writer with self-re-verifying stale guards. As product surface, the news voice is consistently house-quality and legible (fragile-artery booms, bucket-neutral calamities, charter-pending steadings), though several receipts (calamity, upswing) still terminate at the pulse seam per the recorded display deferral. Grade A-: mature, constitutionally serious code whose remaining defects are cross-wave contract enforcement, not craftsmanship.
strengths: Constitutional discipline is uniform and real: every mover in the slice has a fail-closed virtual-flag dormancy gate returning identical references, drop-when-empty ledgers, codepoint-sorted iteration, and catch-up-safe tick-stamp dwells (upswing, resource dynamics, lifecycle, generosity all match the pattern).

Force ≡ organic is structurally enforced, not asserted: FORCE_CALAMITY/FORCE_FOUND_STEADING/FORCE_ABANDON/FORCE_RESETTLE all resolve through the same shared kernel resolvers the organic lanes use, and realmManifest.js consumes the same entry factories.

The W-DISCOVERY↔W-UPSWING seam is consumed correctly in both directions: vein_exhausted feeds the B2 bust flip (with dormancy-safe reads), resource_strike joins the boom source receipts and the satellite mining-camp birth trigger.

The calamity bucket is genuinely type-blind (mechanics never branch on the flavor hint; bucket-neutral prose) and exposure loading preserves the fixed realm strike budget exactly (mean-1 normalization).

Conservation at the satellite-lane edges is real and receipted: founding debits the parent above its tier floor, growth is a transfer, convergence sums, abandonment returns the residual; the lifecycle writers carry self-re-verify stale guards for late-applied proposals.

Two GIVE verdicts to one giver both price the full headroom. grep: triageAllocation has zero production consumers (tests only).

findings.title: Boom hysteresis exit is unimplemented — BOOM_EXIT_THROUGHPUT is consumed only pre-mint, so a boom never cools and can band-step prosperity up forever
findings.evidence: Tuning :111 documents BOOM_EXIT_THROUGHPUT 1.5 as "hysteresis: below this a boom cools (not yet bust)", but grep shows its only consumer is the 'building' branch (:628). The boom-sustain branch checks only severed = embattled || throughput < BUST_THROUGHPUT(1.0) || veinGone.
findings.why: A boom whose throughput settles into [1.0, 1.5) sustains indefinitely, drifting prosperity up a band every ~7 ticks until the ladder cap — the documented graceful-cooling path is dead, so booms can only end in a bust condition (a crisis) even when trade merely normalizes.
findings.fix_shape: Add a cooling branch to the boom phase: throughput < BOOM_EXIT_THROUGHPUT (and not severed) ⇒ drop the boom record + clear the boom condition without the bust retreat/legitimacy hit; receipt it as boom_cooled.
findings.deferral_checked: DESIGN_UPSWING §2 B2 + §5 deferrals (hysteresis is specced, cooling not deferred); playbook W-UPSWING ledger row and memory w-upswing-shipped deferrals — not recorded.

findings.title: Upswing ally-credit maturation double-decays the entire obligations ledger on the same tick

findings.title: Terminal death of a parent with live satellite steadings strands them frozen in the ledger, outside the conservation story
findings.evidence: if (parent0.lifecycleStatus || parent0.config?.lifecycleStatus) continue; // remnants seed nothing — the continue skips B2 (grow/starve/return), B3, B4, and B5 entirely, so a dead parent's steadings never starve, never return residents, and persist in spatialLedgers.satellites indefinitely.

findings.fix_shape: On terminal death (or in the satellite lane when the parent reads as a remnant): run the abandonment path for each steading — residual population disperses through the same migration ledger as the parent's, records removed, receipted; pin over a die-with-steadings fixture.
findings.deferral_checked: DESIGN_SETTLEMENT_LIFECYCLE §1/§4 (conservation pin claims Σ across ANY lifecycle event; V2 graduation is the only recorded seam); playbook W-LIFECYCLE row — not recorded.

subsystems.holistic: This slice is the strongest structural-prevention work in the repo, with a thin but real last-mile gap between the domain machinery and the DM's eye. The domain core is genuinely excellent. The phantom-event hole — round 1's sharpest finding — is closed at all three mouths with one mechanism: mutateSettlementChecked's typed veto channel (47 vetoMutation call sites across mutateEntities/mutateWorld), the pipeline's shared abort envelope (no deltas, no narration on veto), the queue mouth (drainQueuedEvents refuses visibly into the advance digest via queueRefusalNews), and the proposal mouth (applyWorldPulseProposal stamps 'refused', never 'applied', when a realm arm declines). Three fail-closed walkers enforce the counterpart criterion structurally: the settlement coverage walker (40 types = 31 authorable + 9 legible folds), the predicate-parity walker (every veto code claimed by a manifest predicate), and the realm coverage walker, which source-scans src/domain/worldPulse for factory-shaped verbs so a future mover literally cannot ship a forceable shape the composer never learns about. The forecast honors its constitution: clone-and-discard through the REAL drain and REAL interval orchestrator, pinned preview≡apply byte-for-byte against the actual committed store advance (tests/joins/realmForecast.test.js), with an inlined UI fingerprint twin drift-pinned by source-string parity. Force≡organic is real, not aspirational — every arm resolves through its wave's own kernel function, re-gated against the current world, PRNG forks keyed on (seed, verb, tick) with kernel-side target keys. The mutable docket honors the sync-prefix law on all three queue mutators, and updateQueuedEvent re-stamps queuedAt so edits void open forecasts. Where the slice falls short is the projection into the product surface. One of the 12 "executable" verbs is functionally dead from the UI: FORCE_RECONSIDERATION's course dial is a '__live__' placeholder nothing resolves, so every composer-staged order refuses at apply — the mint gate passes, the proposal queues, and the approval contradicts the docket with "holds no committed course to press." The forecast's headline design deliverable — marginal attribution (with-vs-without a staged candidate) — is built and tested in the domain but has zero UI consumers, and forecastDigest's realm-scope beats are computed then dropped by the pane. The staleness fingerprint approximates "world-state" with the tick, so rules flips, party impacts, and relationship ripples leave an open forecast claiming to be the next tick when it no longer is. And two id-collision classes (proposal ids that exclude args, refusal-news ids that exclude the actor) can silently overwrite decision history or merge two refusals into one feed entry. None of these undermine determinism, dormancy, or the premium seam — all constitution laws held everywhere I traced — but they mean the wave's promise ("every capability forceable, every preview honest") is about 90% delivered at the surface where the DM actually lives. As simulation substance the lane design (force-as-proposal, one lane for 12 verbs) is elegant and cheap; as product surface it needs one more wiring pass.
strengths: The phantom-event hole is closed by one mechanism at all three mouths (pipeline veto channel, queue-mouth drain refusals, proposal-mouth 'refused' status) with visible typed refusals — round 1's sharpest class is structurally dead, and batch.js's hard-ref census cites the round-1 finding ids in-code.

Three fail-closed walkers (settlement coverage, predicate-parity, realm coverage with a source-scan of worldPulse for factory shapes and a shrink-only PARKED ledger at ceiling 0) make the Counterpart Criterion unforgeable by future waves.

Preview≡apply for the forecast is pinned byte-for-byte against the REAL committed store advance (joins pin), with clone-and-discard no-commit discipline and replay determinism pinned; the UI fingerprint twin is drift-pinned by verbatim source-string parity.

Force ≡ organic is genuinely implemented: every realm arm resolves through its wave's own kernel function (declareCasus, planConvoy/planBlockade, forceCalamityStrike, forceFoundSteading, buildTerminalDeathOutcome), re-gated against the CURRENT world, with lifecycle verbs substituting the organic outcome through the standard apply lane — zero new apply paths.

The mutable docket honors the owner's law end-to-end: cancel/edit-in-place with same queueId, queuedAt re-stamp (voids forecasts), advance-in-flight + parked-pause sync-prefix guards on every queue mutator, LAPSED marking with teaching prose, and editSeed's honest field coverage.
First-paint discipline: realmManifest and affordanceManifest are lazy leaves with dist-guard sentinels; the whole W-COMPOSER-2 wave landed net-negative on the ratchet.

Unavailability teaches everywhere — grayed-with-reason predicates naming the exact flags, veto prose with no fallback shrug (walked), and the two honestly-deferred verbs (REINFORCE/INTERCEPT) registered grayed with their deferral named in-file.

findings.title: Forecast staleness fingerprint misses tick-neutral world mutations — rules edits, party impacts, and relationship ripples leave an open forecast claiming to be the next tick

A DM flipping calamityEnabled or landing a party impact materially changes the simulated future, yet the pane still asserts 'Barring further edits, this IS the next tick' — a doc-vs-code drift against the design's own REALM-WIDE STALENESS law.

subsystems.holistic:
This slice is the strongest sustained engineering in the codebase, and round 2 finds it materially better than round 1 left it. Every headline round-1 defect is verifiably fixed on this lineage: the M5 retreat machinery is consumed (armyTransitKernel/warDeployment import retreatRoute), the courier umbilical is read (staleAssessment/umbilicalFog consumers), the M11a graded plague reads have kernel consumers, calamityHistory has a display ledger, disastersEnabled is lit in the full_simulation preset, and — the deepest fix — the frozen digest is now Object.freeze'd and reference-shared through ensureWorldState (FROZEN_CONDITIONAL_LEDGER_KEYS), which restores every WeakMap memo in distanceRead to true once-per-canonize semantics instead of missing on each tick's clone. That fix was done the bold way (an enforced immutability contract) rather than the patch way, exactly per constitution law 6.

As code, the discipline is remarkably uniform across 26 files written over many waves: every mover has the same activation-gate shape, the same {next: prior, changed:false} dormant no-op that preserves an existing ledger, the same drop-when-empty sparsity under the single spatialLedgers namespace, codepoint-sorted mutation order, stable composite PRNG fork keys, and 4-dp rounding for byte-tidy persistence. Determinism is not asserted but argued — the digest builder documents WHY its Dijkstra tie-breaks are provably deterministic. Conservation invariants (migration Σ, goods before+produced == after+consumed+lost, seizure takes re-credited to the gate) are built assertable, not incidental. The overlay-chokepoint pattern (self-describing frozen slots read leaf-side in distanceRead; catalog-pulling builders kept out of the light chunk) is executed identically for seasons, sea lanes, and teleport — three waves, one pattern, zero drift.

As simulation substance, the movers genuinely compose rather than coexist: entrepôt tolls join the M1 re-score and divert routes; the M6c refusal signal is exactly what M7 smuggling harvests; refuge postures join M4's destination score; blockades ride the existing routeIntercepted seam; the naval layer honors the frozen M8 slot while superseding its combat boundary in a sibling ledger. The counterpart criterion holds (FORCE_CALAMITY et al. registered via the composer wave, with severity bands pinned to force≡organic at moderate).

The findings that remain are seams between representations, not defects within them — and they cluster in the owner's most-bitten class. The banditry/route-danger contradiction (loss keyed on the one node route scoring excludes) is the only place two danger models in the same file family disagree. The commodityFlowEnabled mid-campaign flip and the re-canonize carryover are both lifecycle paths where correct-per-tick machinery meets an unreconciled transition with no recorded decision — small in code, but exactly the write-that-ghosts-another-path failure the program exists to catch. None threaten byte-identity or determinism; all are bounded in blast radius.

Product-surface-wise the slice is honest about legibility: receipts are mandatory and mostly excellent, though the "a tenth of what was asked" hardcode shows the receipt discipline can drift from the numbers it narrates. Grade A: mature, constitution-conformant, self-documenting engine code whose remaining risk is transition seams, not mechanisms.
strengths: Frozen-digest law enforced structurally, not by convention: deepFreeze + reference-sharing in ensureWorldState turns the never-written contract into a throwing guarantee and restores all distanceRead WeakMap memos (round-1 perf class closed the bold way)

Uniform mover discipline across 26 files/11 waves: identical activation gates, dormant {next:prior, changed:false} no-ops, drop-when-empty sub-ledgers under one spatialLedgers namespace, codepoint-sorted mutation, stable composite fork keys — a new mover ledger costs zero eager bytes by construction
Conservation as first-class assertable invariants: migration Σarrivals+deaths==departures, goods before+produced==after+consumed+lost with seizure takes re-credited, exact integers by construction
Determinism argued, not asserted: the digest Dijkstra documents why its tie-breaks are provably deterministic; lower-median calibration; every draw preceded by a total-order sort

The overlay-chokepoint pattern executed three times without drift (seasonalOverlay/seaLanes/teleportEdges): self-describing frozen slots, leaf-side reads, builder/catalog kept out of the light chunk, dormancy floor = null slot = byte-identical

Real cross-mover composition: tolls join the M1 re-score, M6c refusals feed M7 smuggling, refuge postures feed M4 destination choice, blockades ride routeIntercepted, sea battles reuse resolveFieldBattle verbatim for land parity
All verified round-1 spatial fixes present and consumed on this lineage (retreat, umbilical, plague couplings, calamity display, preset lighting) — no regressions found

Bounded-brake culture: every positive feedback ships with its co-built damper (hysteresis deadbands, throughput ceilings, scatter floors, survivor floors, no-hand-of-miracle clamps), each named and owner-retunable

subsystems.holistic: This slice is the causal substrate the whole product stands on — the 16-variable causal state, the 9-capacity supply/demand model, conditions, threats, chains, the derivation layer feeding the AI dossier — and it is in genuinely strong shape. The round-1 highs in this territory (ASSIGN_NPC_TO_ROLE lobotomizing NPCs, the regeneration canon-loss family, institution-to-faction propagation never firing) are verifiably fixed in code, each with an in-file comment naming the finding id it closes. The dominant architectural pattern since round 1 is structural prevention rather than patching: the five conserved ledgers (food/governance/defense/magic/healing) are single read-points that killed the parallel-model bug class; applyConditions is a single condition-scan chokepoint with a pinned no-hand-roll test after the polarity bug appeared three times; crisisLifecycle routes one crisis's three representations through one transition function with declarative twin directives; covert-corruption visibility runs through one isCovertOnlyImpairment definition shared by status, propagation, and public derived state. Determinism discipline is consistent and explicit — injected rng, codepoint sorts, no wall-clock in pure pipelines, deterministic ids with idempotency contracts — and first-paint budget reasoning is visible in file-split decisions (rulingPowerCoup, corruptionLeash, stressorsCore imports). The §10 tuning rails ship empty with a structural validator and a golden-law lane-B override, exactly matching the recorded INERT-by-design deferral. As simulation substance, the substrate composes well: lifts and pressures are signed by one polarity function, war-economy and religion seams thread through the same condition scan, and dormancy/additivity is honored everywhere I traced (deity terms, piety amplifiers, and war archetypes all read absent-as-1.0/skip). The defects that remain are real but second-order, and they cluster in two shapes. First, vocabulary drift at module seams: the law_order alias still routes law-pressure conditions to criminal_opportunity because a comment-era premise ("law_order is not a real causal variable") is now false, and the npc rank vocabulary ('subordinate' emitted, 'secondary' templated) leaves a consequence tier dead. Second, invariants asserted in prose but enforced only one tick deep: the condition-drift "no invented motion" rule is defeated by its own canonical write-back on the second tick, and the polarity-safe band-word helper is consumed by no view, including the one its doc names. None of these violate the constitution; the two that would shift bytes on fix (law_order alias, drift write-back) need the explicit behavior-shift statement and an aiGrounding-bundle rebuild, since activeConditions/causalState are bundle inputs whose edits red the freshness gate. The remaining round-1 lows in the owner-gated schema file (unterminated JSDoc, 14-vs-16 union) simply never got a fix wave and are now joined by a fresh band-boundary doc drift (schema says ≥55/≥35, code says ≥50/≥30). As product surface, the derivations reach the user's eye well — every score carries contributors, every slot carries references, and the causal-view/daily-life prose is grounded rather than invented — with the one legibility exception recorded below. Graded as mature production code for a deterministic simulator of this ambition, this is A- work: the architecture actively prevents its own historical bug classes, and what remains is seam hygiene, not structural weakness.
strengths: The conserved-ledger family (foodLedger/governanceLedger/defenseLedger/magicLedger/healingLedger) — single read-points with present-flags and neutral defaults that structurally killed the parallel-model and stale-vocabulary bug classes, each documenting the exact bug it cures.

applyConditions in causalState.js: one condition-scan implementation with signed/drain/gain modes, LIFT_ARCHETYPES sourced from the archetype catalog, and a test (causalStateConditionScan.test.js) pinning that no deriver hand-rolls the join — textbook structural prevention after a 3x-repeated polarity bug.

crisisLifecycle.js: one authored crisis, three representations, one transition vocabulary — twin directives consumed at a single store chokepoint, dual-written stressorEdits/eventConditions records that survive regeneration, and windDownCrisis matching both write paths with campaign-ownership guards. The in-file documentation of every lifecycle path is exemplary.

Covert-corruption discipline: isCovertOnlyImpairment shared by effectiveStatus/withImpairment/deriveSystemState so a covert capture never leaks into visible derived state — the premium/covert seam honored at the substrate level, not just the display level.

Determinism throughout: injected rng in resolveCoupVerdict, codepoint-order tiebreaks with localeCompare explicitly banned, deterministic content-ids in normalizeSettlement (with a rename-stable structural fingerprint), no wall-clock in pure pipelines (withImpairment refusing to default appliedAt).

The §10 auto-tuning rails: AUTO_TUNABLE ships empty, the validator makes sim/generation surfaces unrepresentable, the lane classifier hard-codes the golden law — the constitutional boundary is executable, not documented.

aiGrounding/aiOverlayVerifier pairing: user direction isolated from the dossier section (prompt-injection posture), locked-entity enumeration, verbatim user-edit preservation checks — defense in depth that matches the canon model.

subsystems.holistic:
This slice is the product's voice, and it is in strong shape — noticeably stronger than at round 1. The architecture is a genuinely coherent doctrine applied ~40 times: pure selectors over live ledgers, inert-not-crash on absent state, codepoint-sorted determinism, fail-closed viewer seams (includeCovert / includeGroundTruth defaulting to the player), engine constants re-exported rather than re-typed, and authored fiction confined to byte-inert lazy sidecars with FNV variant selection so the same world always speaks the same line. The discipline is not just asserted but enforced: the publicSafe top-level allowlist is pinned character-identical to the SQL sanitizer, the marketPrices band mirror is drift-pinned against COMMODITY_TUNING, the glossary is coverage-pinned both directions against live registries, guidance whispers live in a walker-checked registry with a shrink-only legacy ceiling, and there is a runtime visibility audit a DM can push a button on. Round-1's four mediums (chronicle id-poisoning, the bare-`note` strip, missing pillar leadership, the missing pestilence read-model) are all demonstrably fixed, each with the finding id cited in-code — the review loop is functioning.

The weaknesses cluster in three places. First, the public world snapshot: it is the one module that mirrors sibling selectors by hand-copy instead of by call-or-pin, and the copies have already forked — the snapshot bakes deity names from slug tails ("The-silent-queen") while the gallery arc summary resolves real names from embedded snapshots. For the module that carries the strictest security posture in the slice, its fidelity/duplication posture lags its security posture. Second, the covert seam is enforced at the selector layer but not at the byte layer: the war_mobilization condition and headline carry no covert marker, so the day covert posture becomes mintable (the ledger and propagation already support it), the fact will walk through activeConditions and the public chronicle even as mobilizationStatus dutifully hides it — the same shape as the recorded owner-gated covert-impairment leak, and the visibilityAudit's "property for every consumer" claim currently overstates its coverage. Third, legibility is falling behind the engine again: the wave cadence (politics blocs, interventions, credibility, momentum, resource dynamics) has outrun the one-mover-one-read-model contract this slice itself articulates, and the calamity ledger read-model sits wired to nothing. This is the same debt class round-1 flagged for pestilence; the fix pattern is now boilerplate and cheap.

As simulation substance, the fiction layer is unusually honest: every phrase is grounded in a real ledger field, the register rules ("no engine tokens", "no decimals", bucket-neutral calamity voice, age-band-gated 'lean years') are documented and mostly test-enforced, and the 168-pair conjunction ladder with class and floor rungs is total by construction. As product surface, the DM genuinely gets a world that speaks — provided the newest mechanisms get their read-model siblings before the soak.

Constitution compliance is otherwise excellent: dormancy shapes are explicit everywhere ([] / null / byte-identical off-state), premium/reveal seams follow the selector convention, endogeneity is honored (marketPrices explicitly derives prices display-side with zero feedback), and first-paint law is enforced with sentinels and zero-import leaves. Grade A-: mature, self-policing code whose remaining faults are drift risk and coverage lag, not design error.
strengths: Fail-closed viewer seams applied consistently: includeGroundTruth/includeCovert default to the player projection across rumors, beliefs, pestilence, mobilization, and trade pressure, with a runtime visibilityAudit tool plus a static twin test

publicSafe's layered model — fail-closed top-level allowlist pinned character-identical to the server SQL, a grow-only recursive denylist, NPC allowlist projection, and documented coupled client+SQL change discipline (the migration-130 note narrowing is exemplary)

The byte-inert sidecar pattern (newsVoice, newsBody, marketPrices, guidanceNotes, the three-rung conjunction ladder): deterministic FNV variant selection, zero engine imports, zero first-paint bytes, enforced by DCE-proof sentinels and dist guards

Re-export-never-retype discipline: deityEffects, pantheonDepth's MAJOR_PROMOTE, mobilizationStatus's feasibility classifier, and warResolve's composeDefenderWillScore all read the engine's own numbers so display cannot disagree with the drive

Round-1 findings fixed with the finding id cited at the fix site (chronicleTimeline domain-readmodels-1, publicSafe domain-readmodels-2/migration 130, warResolve domain-readmodels-3, settlementPestilence domain-readmodels-4) — a working review loop

subsystems.holistic:
This slice is some of the most disciplined domain code in the repo, and the discipline is structural, not cosmetic. The regional engine (graph/propagation/wizardNews) threads a deterministic `now` through every mutator with wall-clock only as an explicitly-documented fallback; retention is engineered rather than hoped for (terminal-impact cap that never drops a queued row, FIFO event log, wizard-news recency-plus-rescued-arc-heads capping — all byte-identical below the bound); and the lifecycle scars of past bites are visible and healed properly (the C1 truncated-condition-id hash with a legacy-id migration on re-apply, the H7 same-shock fold, the ordered three-phase apply in the store slice that refuses to advertise 'applied' before the settlement is durable). The townMap model is a genuinely exemplary deterministic projection — internal PRNG from the seed, a hand-computed integer compass table instead of trig, anchor-keyed cosmetic edits that normalize to null so absence is byte-identity. The dossier aggregators (plotHooks dedupe with echo-family collapsing, chronicleFeed, tonightAtTheTable) are modest, pure, and honest about what the generators actually emit.

The two soft spots are composition seams, not module-level quality. First, the G1d relief lane — round 1's headline regional fix — landed slightly under-composed with the machinery around it: the H7 fold groups all relief at a target under one key and drops the displaced impacts' relievesArchetype, and the apply step clears every same-archetype condition regardless of source or goods. Both are one-key fixes, but until then a multi-channel recovery under-relieves and a single-channel recovery over-relieves — visible causality incoherence in the engine whose product thesis is visible causality. Second, the guidance layer's substrate (registry, notes sidecar, unified dismissal store, generated glossary with byte-identity freshness) is excellent, but its enforcement has a hole exactly where the slice-attention asked me to look: the walker's 'mounted' check is file-existence, and its census is a filename regex, so 'registered' has quietly diverged from 'rendered'. The W-COMPOSER-2 mechanism whispers, the realm empty invitation's registered prose, and the preserved PostGenCoach steps are all walker-green copy no user can ever see, while the wave ledger records the whispers as shipped. The registry risks becoming a compliance artifact rather than the teaching inventory it was designed to be; the fix is the source-census cross-check its own header already promises. Relatedly, the compendium global search — built to close the 'I know the word, not the tab' gap — has reopened that gap for the Living World tab added since, with a comment-only mirror contract.

As simulation substance the slice composes well: the shock/relief symmetry, discovery honoring the trade layer's hostile-no-trade rule, the contest primitive's determinism-and-incumbency contract, and arc-threaded news all serve the DM's read. As product surface, the wizard-news threading and glossary are strong; the guidance gaps are the difference between an A- and an A. Test culture (walkers, ratchets, freshness pins, negative controls) is a real asset — it just needs its mount checks to bite.
strengths: Determinism engineering is pervasive and real: threaded `now` through every graph/feed mutator, internal seed-derived PRNG + integer compass table (no trig) in townMapModel, codepoint sorts before every output-feeding iteration, FNV/log-odds contest math with an explicit cross-platform caveat recorded in-file.

Year-two-feels-like-day-one retention design: REGIONAL_TERMINAL_IMPACT_LIMIT (queued rows sacred, oldest terminal dropped), event-log FIFO cap, wizard-news capEntries with bounded major-arc rescue — each byte-identical below its bound and documented with measured headroom.

Lifecycle scar tissue done right: legacy truncated condition-id migration on re-apply, conditionId preservation across re-queues, the ordered settlement-first/graph-second apply that closes the split-truth reload bug, advance-in-flight guards.

Structural prevention culture: the ensured-brand idempotency short-circuit whose safety derives from spread/clone stripping the brand; shrink-only ratchets (title census, legacy guidance ledger); the generated glossary's byte-identity freshness test with both-directions coverage and the never-leak-a-slug law.

The relief lane (G1d) genuinely closes round-1's one-way-doom asymmetry with bounded design (single-hop, no wave inversion, positive news register) — the two remaining scoping bugs are refinements, not regressions.
contestOverThirdParty/contestMath is a clean shared primitive: one fork-key recipe, canonical ordering before sampling, an explicit anti-churn balance contract distinct from the coup resolver.

mapEdits container honors the dormancy law rigorously: normalize-to-null so absence is byte-identity, denylist-safe schema keys pinned against the public-projection strip trap, anchor-keyed (never coordinate/random-id) pins.

subsystems.holistic:
This slice is the strongest kind of mature simulation code: a topologically-sorted 21-step pipeline where every step gets a name-keyed PRNG fork (reorder-stable determinism), every draw rides a fail-closed rng context that throws on unseeded use, and every decision leaves a structured trace receipt. The constitution is not aspirational here — it is enforced in mechanism. Same-seed byte-identity is engineered at every seam: codepoint sorts (never localeCompare) before rng-consuming loops over custom content, edit overlays (resourceEdits/stressorEdits/customTradeGoods) that re-apply DM deltas post-roll while consuming zero rng so edit-free configs replay byte-identically, and a deterministic trace clock replacing Date.now. Dormancy is exemplary in seedStartingPantheon: the latent pantheon bakes identically for every tier, activation is a separate rng-free seam, and the rail summary is counts-only so no generation-time surface can name a latent deity — the premium seam honored structurally, not by convention. The strict-mode write-set contract (provides/mutates/scratch) plus the reads-soundness cross-check test is genuine architectural prevention, and the Wave-4b damped fixpoint (provisional economy → power → faction pull → economy reconcile on the final roster) is honestly documented where it is deliberately incomplete. Round-1 remediation quality is high: pipeline-1 through -7 are all verifiably fixed in code with finding-ID markers and shared predicates extracted (categoryToggleReader, isAdversarialRelationship) rather than point patches. 67 test files pin determinism, strict mode, rng restore, config seams, and catalog reachability.

The defects that remain cluster at two edges. First, protection-semantics drift: the codebase has a stated principle — required/forced/custom institutions are "contract with the DM" — that applySubsumption and cullPlanarWithoutCircle enforce but collapseUpgradeChains (protects only 'required') and applySubsistenceMode (spares only required/forced) do not, so a DM-forced or user-authored institution can still be silently deleted by two of the four roster-pruning mechanisms, and the main-assembly ladder collapse emits no trace at all. Second, lifecycle asymmetry on the section-regen and legacy-config paths: the NPC reroll now runs the coherence tail (round-1 fix) but still skips corruption onset entirely, producing rosters systematically cleaner than generation would mint and erasing the explicit generation-decided markers; the history reroll drops its seed despite the module contract promising _regenSeed; and stripDerivedConfigKeys — the guard against emergent stress echoing back as user-forced input — is defined, tested, and never called, while eight files attribute the protection to a settlementSlice.applyChange function that does not exist. That last one is the most characteristic risk in this codebase: the comments assert a safety property the wiring no longer implements, which is exactly what a successor AI will trust.

As product surface, the pipeline rail + receipts layer makes the mechanism unusually legible — the honest-receipts work (identity-relationship neighbours say "no mechanical bias") is the kind of anti-overclaiming discipline most simulators never do. Nothing here reads tick state; generation inputs are config, toggles, custom-content snapshot, and the imported neighbour, exactly as the law requires. Grade A-: the core is A+ engineering, held back by the contract-drift edges and the dead protective seam.
strengths: Fail-closed rng discipline: rngContext throws on any unseeded draw in every environment, unseededRandom() is the single greppable escape hatch, and per-step name-keyed PRNG forks make the draw stream invariant under step reordering.

Same-seed byte-identity engineered at every seam: codepoint sorts before rng-consuming custom-content loops, zero-rng edit overlays (resourceEdits/stressorEdits/customTradeGoods) that keep edit-free configs byte-identical, deterministic _traceClock instead of wall-clock.

seedStartingPantheon is a model of the dormancy + premium constitution: latent record identical for all tiers, activation is a separate rng-free seam, counts-only rail summary so no generation surface can name a latent deity.

Strict-mode data-flow contract (provides/mutates/scratch write-sets + reads soundness cross-check in dataFlowContract.test.js) is real structural prevention, honestly documented where versioned keys would be needed to go further.

Trace-receipt discipline with anti-overclaiming: honest receipts gate every downstream-effect claim on the mechanism actually being non-identity (resolveNeighbour), and silent overrides (isolated-route rewrite, plagued military floor) now always leave receipts.

Round-1 remediation done right: pipeline-1..7 all verifiably fixed with in-code finding markers and shared predicates extracted (categoryToggleReader, isAdversarialRelationship, collapse/subsumption re-used at every roster-mutation site).
Deep test moat: 67 generator test files including pipelineStrictMode, pipelineRngRestore, regenRngRestore, configSeamContract, customContentDeterminism, metropolisCatalogReachable.
generateSettlementPipeline fails closed on the options-in-the-neighbour-slot misuse — the exact silent-seed-loss class the kernel exists to prevent.

findings.title: stripDerivedConfigKeys is dead code — the derived-config echo guard is never called, and 8+ files attribute it to a nonexistent applyChange flow
findings.evidence: grep across src/: only the definition (settlementSlice.js:185) and tests call it. assembleSettlement.js:112 claims 'applyChange regenerates from _config below, and its legacy fallback strips the derived keys'; no applyChange function exists anywhere in src (grep). SettlementsPanel.jsx:90 legacy fallback `data.config` → migrateConfig (no strip) → updateConfig.
findings.why: The guard exists precisely so emergent stress can't echo back as user-forced input: a legacy save whose stored config is a resolved snapshot re-enters generation with stressTypes/tier/terrainType/_magicTradeOnly/neighborRelationship intact — resolveStress records them as intendedStressTypes and stressConfirmPass then never drops them. Tests assert the strip's behavior, giving false assurance it is wired.
findings.fix_shape: Wire stripDerivedConfigKeys into every path that feeds a possibly-resolved config back into generation (SettlementsPanel.onLoad fallback, any _config-absent fallback), or make migrateConfig call it. Sweep the eight 'applyChange' comments to name the real flow (onLoad → updateConfig → generateSettlement). Pin with a legacy-save round-trip test.
findings.deferral_checked: Round-1 register grep: stripDerivedConfigKeys/applyChange never mentioned; playbook 0.0.2 + DEAD_CODE_DISPOSITION: no entry. Fresh finding.

findings.title: collapseUpgradeChains deletes DM-forced and custom institutions — protection semantics contradict the subsumption pass's 'contract with the DM' rule, and main-assembly collapses leave no trace
findings.evidence: `institutions.findIndex(i => i.name === lesser && i.source !== 'required')` — only 'required' is protected. subsumptionPass.js:77 PROTECTED_SOURCES = {required, forced, custom} ('contract with the DM'). At the assemble call site (line 437) the removed-names return is discarded — no recordTrace, unlike the cascade/faction call sites.
findings.why: A DM force-requiring a lesser ladder member (Town granary, Blacksmith, Apothecary — pairs without exclusive groups) in a settlement that rolls the greater sees their explicit toggle silently deleted with no receipt; a custom institution named to match a catalog lesser is likewise removable. Two of the four roster-pruning mechanisms honor the DM contract, two do not.
findings.fix_shape: Give collapseUpgradeChains the same isProtectedInstitution guard subsumption uses (required/forced/custom), and emit ladder-collapse traces at the assemble call site. If forced-lesser removal is intended ('force means at-least-this-scale'), record that decision and trace it instead.
findings.deferral_checked: Round-1 register + playbook grep for UPGRADE_CHAINS/collapse: only the settlement-map demotion note (playbook:982, different mechanism). Not recorded.

findings.title: applySubsistenceMode strips user-authored custom institutions on isolated thorps/hamlets — the only roster-pruning path that ignores source:'custom'
findings.evidence: `if (inst.required || inst.source === 'forced') return false;` — 'custom' not spared; an untagged custom institution also fails the keep-tags fallback (`return !tags.some(t => keepTags.includes(t))`) and is spliced. Contrast cullPlanarWithoutCircle line 167 which spares required/forced/custom/forcedByIsolation.
findings.why: §14 injection (assembleInstitutions) deliberately seats tier-gated, possibly essential custom institutions; on an isolated thorp/hamlet the subsistence strip then deletes them — user-authored compendium content vanishing on one config axis, against the codebase's own custom-protection principle. stripArcaneInstitutions (line 181) likewise spares forced but not custom in no-magic worlds.
findings.fix_shape: Add `|| inst.source === 'custom' || inst.isCustom` to the subsistence spare-list (and decide/record the stripArcaneInstitutions custom case — arguably intended there). Pin with an isolated-thorp + essential-custom-institution test.
findings.deferral_checked: No in-file deferral note; round-1 register and playbook greps for subsistence/custom-strip: nothing recorded.

Round-1 domain-3 fixed the coherence tail but left corruption out of the shared regen path.

findings.title: regenHistoryPipeline drops its minted seed — module contract promises _regenSeed persistence that only the NPC twin delivers
findings.evidence: Docstring: 'Re-generate history… Seeded like regenNPCsPipeline'; module doc line 101: 'The seed used is returned on `_regenSeed` so the caller can persist it for replay.' The function returns generateHistory(...) directly — the seed is unrecoverable. The NPC path's _regenSeed lands on the settlement via Object.assign (settlementSlice.js:1174) and is strip-listed in publicSafe.

findings.evidence: `getBaseChance((def.baseChance || 0) * multiplier, catalogCat, name, config, null, {})` — neighbor=null, goodsToggles={} where assembleInstitutions.js:291 passes `neighbourProfile || importedNeighbor, goodsToggles`.

subsystems.holistic:
This slice is in markedly better shape than its round-1 B+. Every round-1 generators-domain finding selected for the fix waves (1–7) is verifiably fixed in the code I read, and — more importantly — fixed with structural prevention rather than patches. The stress-type registration walker (tests/data/stressTypeRegistration.test.js) is a model of the genre: it import-checks six exported tables, source-scans seven function-local tables by brace-matched block, verifies every STRESS_TO_TENSION target resolves to a real template with a title, and even audits its own exemption list against live source so a renamed table cannot leave a stale silent exemption. The dual food model is genuinely reconciled: generateFoodSecurity is the single writer, viability threads it through (viability.js:490), and foodBalance's canonical-reconcile block rebuilds import/magic attribution to sum exactly to the canonical gap. The id-first join work in computeActiveChains is architecturally elegant — pattern→catalog-id sets are built FROM the legacy fuzzy matcher, so id-match equals name-match by construction (golden-stable) while stamped institutions become rename-proof. RNG-draw-order discipline is documented at nearly every refactored branch (drawUnique consumes exactly one roll like the pick it replaced; the roll/render stress-summary split preserves draw position), which is exactly what the same-seed constitution requires of code that keeps being edited.

As simulation substance, the second-wave stress types (insurgency, mass_migration, wartime, religious_conversion, slave_revolt) are now richly integrated at the content layer — arrival vignettes, NPC goals/secrets/mandatory roles, faction injections (stressFactions' wartime/conversion/revolt blocks are some of the best authored material in the repo), safety labels, crime menus, shadow-economy weights, probability couplings. The one substantive gap left is numeric: the defense-score stress-penalty block, the food-production stress multipliers, and (for slave_revolt) the prosperity penalties still enumerate only the original ten types, and those inline blocks are the one consumer family the registration walker cannot see. A wartime settlement reads wartime everywhere except in the numbers that drive readiness and legitimacy. That is my only medium finding, and it is the same bug class round-1 named — half-closed rather than re-opened.

As code, the main residue is deliberate-looking dead weight: four underscore-prefixed dead locals in npcGenerator (one a drifted near-duplicate of the live computeRelTension, a real trap), economicState's built-then-wiped heuristic export lists, an unreachable governance ternary in the de-minified rulingStructure, and the round-1 lows (-8/-9/-10/-11) that were triaged out of the fix waves and are all still present verbatim. subsystems.holistic:
This slice is the product's face for the whole simulation, and it is genuinely strong — among the most disciplined UI code I have reviewed at this scale. The architecture is coherent: WorldMap is a thin controller over the Zustand map slice and an FMG iframe bridge; MapOverlay mirrors the d3 zoom transform by direct DOM writes with a debounced, mode-tagged viewport persist; every engine-fact layer (relationship edges, war/faith channels, regional causality, war glyphs, lifecycle ruins/steadings) is a pure read-model projection that self-gates to nothing on a dormant world. The constitution is visibly load-bearing here, not decorative — dormancy comments cite the law, hidden/gm channel visibility is honored identically across three independent layers, BeliefDivergenceBand is an exemplary fail-closed includeGroundTruth consumer, and the locked anon/free dashboard teaser keeps the premium seam clean while staying reachable. Round-1's highs in this slice (the MapOverlay transformOut prop-contract break, the World-Laws "arrives with the map engine" lie, the unwired causalByTick diff) are all verifiably fixed, with the fixes annotated by finding id in-code — the review program is working.

The W-COMPOSER-2 surfaces are honest in the way the design demands: the Docket shows real drain order with visible LAPSED refusals, the Forecast prints its ceteris-paribus caveat and voids itself on a drift-pinned fingerprint, and the verb composer renders grayed-with-reason. The SM-2/SM-3 town map is a small gem — deterministic view-time derivation, single-writer commit through applyMapEdit, tier-neutral layout.

The defects that remain cluster in two classes. First, single-source drift — the exact P11/P2 class this codebase fights elsewhere: the relationship palette now exists in three copies (canonical relationshipEdgeStyle.js, a matching literal copy in LayersPanel, a divergent-hue copy in RoutesToolbar whose chips don't match the drawn edges), and war/faith channels are drawn twice by two layers in two different purples with only one documented in the legend. Second, wave-velocity staleness: the autosave hook still uses the count-only dirty key that AutoSaveChip's own docstring calls a bug (so drag-moves and renames flip the chip to "Unsaved changes" forever but never autosave — the owner's most-bitten write-ghosts-a-path class, on a default-on flag, with manual Save deliberately demoted); the Pantheon section still advertises "Sue for Peace — coming soon" a wave after SUE_FOR_PEACE shipped in the realm manifest; WorldMap still narrates an FMG re-restore that the bridge side documents as a no-op. None of these are deep, but the first one can silently lose cross-device work.

Legibility of new engine facts is good-but-trailing: lifecycle ruins, steading orbits, and charter rings render on the map but the legend doesn't explain them; calamity stamps and naval facts (blockades, convoys) have no map presence — the latter matching the recorded §7.2 map-as-legibility backlog and W-UPSWING's calamityLedger deferral, so gaps there are known, not new. Overall: mature, self-documenting, constitutionally literate code whose main risk is that its own single-source conventions erode at the edges as waves land faster than the sweeps that police them.
strengths: Visibility-is-law discipline is uniform: hidden/gm channel gates implemented identically in RelationshipEdges, RegionalCausalityLayer, and WarFaithMapOverlay; covert mobilizers DM-only; BeliefDivergenceBand fail-closed on includeGroundTruth; RealmDashboard locked teaser keeps tier off the map surface.

The overlay/transform threading contract is now correct and documented end-to-end: stable transformOut ref, mode-tagged viewport (setMapViewport stamps image/fmg), and both mode-switch paths reset the camera so a stale-space viewport can never be fed to the wrong renderer.

Undo discipline: MAP_UNDO_KEYS scopes snapshots away from the ~1MB fmgSnapshot blob; all three annotation layers push exactly one undo entry per drag; SM-3 town-map edits ride the applyMapEdit persist triple with optimistic local state.

W-COMPOSER-2 surfaces are honest by construction: docket entries show real drain order with visible LAPSED refusals, the forecast staleness fingerprint is drift-pinned by test against the domain module, and unavailable verbs are grayed WITH the reason as visible text.

Every panel self-gates to byte-identical nothing on a dormant world (hasPantheon, hasTreaties, hasLiveWarState, hasBeliefMaps, WhileYouWereAway, WarFaithMapOverlay empty read-models) — the dormancy law observed at the UI layer, not just the engine.

Round-1 fixes landed properly and are annotated by finding id in-code (components-dossier-1/2/4/7 all verified fixed); first-paint consciousness is pervasive (lazy-chunk rationale comments, icon-reuse notes, TreatyPanel static-in-lazy-chunk note citing the enforcing test).
